items.question: How long does onboarding take?
items.answer: Most locations are fully operational within one business day. We help you import your menu, set up delivery zones, and connect your team to their Telegram bots.

items.question: Can I keep my current POS?
items.answer: Toster has its own POS module, but we also have an open API for custom integrations. Talk to us about your current setup.

items.question: How does Toster handle multiple countries?
items.answer: Natively. Each division can have its own currency, language, tax rules, and payment gateway. Fiscalization is handled automatically per jurisdiction.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Yes. Data is isolated per organization at the database level. We use JWT authentication, HMAC-signed webhooks, audit logs on every change, and rate limiting. GDPR-compliant with data export and deletion endpoints.

items.question: Do you support aggregators?
items.answer: We support 11 aggregator platforms natively: Bolt, Glovo, Wolt, DoorDash, UberEats, GrubHub, JustEat, Pyszne.pl, DameJidlo, and more. Orders come in unified, statuses sync back automatically.

items.question: What if I only have one location?
items.answer: Toster works great for single locations. You get the full platform and can add more locations whenever you're ready — no migration needed.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Pricing is based on your number of locations and order volume. Request a demo and we'll put together a proposal that fits your scale.

hero.h1: The CRM built for food delivery chains, not single restaurants
hero.sub: One platform handles every channel: phone, web, Telegram, POS, and 11 aggregators. Track every courier. Display every order in the kitchen. Automate repeat customers.

pain.h2: The problems we solve for food delivery chains

items.title: Order chaos across 5+ channels
items.body: Your team juggles phone calls, Telegram messages, aggregator tablets, and website orders simultaneously. Mistakes happen. Orders get lost. Customers leave one-star reviews.

items.title: Couriers don't know where to go next
items.body: Without route optimization, couriers choose their own path. Late deliveries pile up. You find out when the 1-star review hits your listing — 45 minutes too late.

items.title: Kitchen doesn't see the full picture
items.body: Printed ticket systems can't handle real-time changes. Rush orders get lost in the pile. Your best cook doesn't know the sushi roll is already 10 minutes behind.

features.h2: What Toster does for your delivery chain

items.title: Unified order queue
items.body: Every channel lands in one Kanban board. Phone orders, Telegram bot orders, your website, POS terminal, Bolt Food, Glovo, Wolt, Uber Eats — one queue, one team, one flow. Switch to table view for high-volume shifts. Filter by status, payment method, or division in one click.

items.title: Kitchen Display System
items.body: Real-time KDS for your kitchen team. Orders appear on screen the moment they're confirmed. Cooks see their assigned rolls, set individual timers, and mark items ready — the system moves the order to packing automatically. No printed tickets, no lost orders, no shouting across the kitchen.

items.title: Live courier tracking
items.body: Every courier shares GPS via the Toster courier bot. The live map updates every 30 seconds. Dispatchers see all active couriers, their assigned orders, current ETAs, and route efficiency. Detect delays before customers notice. Assign the nearest available courier automatically.

items.title: AI demand forecasting
items.body: Claude-powered AI analyzes your order history, weather patterns, and day-of-week trends to forecast demand by hour. Your kitchen preps the right amount of ingredients — reducing food waste by up to 25% and eliminating peak-time stock-outs that cost you orders.

items.title: Customer loyalty program
items.body: 1% cashback on every order, applied automatically. Customers can redeem up to 30% of their subtotal with accumulated bonuses. No loyalty cards, no manual tracking — the system handles it. Average repeat order rate increases 18% within 90 days of enabling the loyalty program.

items.title: Managed marketing campaigns
items.body: Email, SMS, push, and Viber campaigns managed by the Toster team via SendPulse. We segment your customers by RFM score, send reactivation flows to churning customers, and push seasonal promotions at the right moment. You get the results — we handle the execution.

items.title: Scaling without chaos
items.body: Add new divisions in minutes. Each location gets its own kitchen display, courier zone, and order queue. Orders route automatically to the nearest available division based on real-time capacity and GPS proximity.

integrations.h2: Integrates with the tools you already use

items.q: What is a food delivery CRM?
items.a: A food delivery CRM is a platform that manages your entire delivery operation: incoming orders from all channels, kitchen production, courier dispatch, customer data, loyalty, and marketing. Unlike a basic POS, it's designed for chains that process hundreds of orders per day across multiple locations.

items.q: How is Toster different from Poster or iiko?
items.a: Poster and iiko are POS-first systems adapted for delivery as an afterthought. Toster was built delivery-first: the data model, the mobile apps, the kitchen display, and courier tracking were all designed around delivery chains. You also get managed marketing and AI automation that Poster and iiko simply don't offer.

items.q: Which aggregators does Toster integrate with?
items.a: Toster currently integrates with Bolt Food, Glovo, Wolt, and Uber Eats. Orders from all aggregators appear in the same Kanban queue alongside your own-channel orders. No separate tablets or manual entry.

items.q: How does the AI voice operator work?
items.a: Incoming calls are handled by an ElevenLabs-powered AI voice agent. It takes the order, confirms the delivery address, and creates the order in Toster automatically. Human operators receive notifications only if the AI cannot handle the request — typically less than 5% of calls.

For Ukraine: LiqPay (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank transfer). For EU markets: Stripe (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay). Cash on delivery is supported everywhere. Payment methods are configurable per location.

items.q: Can I track couriers in real time?
items.a: Yes. Every courier shares GPS via the Toster courier Telegram bot. The management map shows all active couriers, their current orders, estimated delivery times, and route history. You can also set delivery zones and automatic courier assignment rules.

Yes. Toster currently operates in Ukraine, Poland, Czech Republic, and Germany. Each country has the correct fiscal compliance integration, local payment gateways, and a fully localized customer interface. Adding a new country takes 1–3 business days.

items.q: How quickly can we go live?
items.a: The Start plan (€250/month, 1 location) can be set up in 1 business day. The full Revenue plan for multi-location chains typically takes 3–7 days, including menu import, staff training, and courier bot setup.

We don't offer a self-serve trial — instead, we run a guided live demo with your actual menu, followed by a paid pilot period. This ensures you see Toster with your real order flow, not a generic sandbox that doesn't reflect your operation.

It means Toster's team runs your campaigns for you — we design, segment, and send email, SMS, Viber, and push notification campaigns using your customer data. You approve the content; we handle the execution and reporting. No marketing hire needed on your end.
